description: This file is a Svelte component implementing a Kanban board interface for task management, including features such as task creation, editing, deletion, drag-and-drop reordering, and attachments.

methods.name: groupTasksByStatus
methods.description: Groups a list of tasks into columns based on their status.

methods.name: handleTaskDrop
methods.description: Handles the drag-and-drop reordering and status change of tasks within columns.

methods.name: openCreateTask
methods.description: Opens modal for creating a new task with specified status.

methods.name: openEditTask
methods.description: Opens modal for editing an existing task.

methods.name: handleTaskSave
methods.description: Saves a new or edited task, including uploading attachments if provided.

methods.name: editReset
methods.description: Resets the task editing form state.

methods.name: confirmDeleteTask
methods.description: Prepares to delete a task by showing confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleFileInput
methods.description: Handles file input change for task attachment uploads.
